description_en: Configures the burstable QPS and mode of an Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
description_zh: 设置DDoS高防实例的弹性QPS和模式
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo modify-elastic-biz-qps --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --biz-mode month --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyElasticBizQps

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The metering method for the burstable QPS. Valid values:

month: Monthly 95th percentile

day: Daily 95th percentile
parameters.help_zh:
弹性QPS的计费模式。取值：
month：月95模式
day：日95模式
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The burstable QPS value. After burstable QPS is enabled, the default value is three times the basic QPS, but it cannot exceed the maximum burstable QPS:

Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) IPv4 instance: The maximum value is 300,000 QPS.

Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) IPv6 instance: The maximum value is 100,000 QPS.

Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instance: The maximum value is 150,000 QPS
parameters.help_zh:
弹性QPS值。开启后弹性QPS默认为保底QPS的三倍，但不能超过弹性QPS最大值：
DDoS高防（中国内地）IPv4实例：最大为300,000 QPS 。
DDoS高防（中国内地）IPv6实例：最大为100,000 QPS  。
DDoS高防（非中国内地）实例：最大为150,000 QPS
parameters.name: ops_elastic_qps

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
